The '''Lerct system''' was a part of the [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a celestial body of the [[Lerct/Legends|same name]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lerct [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA" />
